upcomingSets.name: Illumineer's Quest: The Great Hunny Rescue
upcomingSets.blurb: This magical willy, nilly, silly old bear glimmer knows that an adventure is always better when taken together. Add a few other Hunny characters to your team and he gives them the sweet treat of extra lore.

upcomingSets.name: Hyperia City
upcomingSets.blurb: This set also marks the debut of ink drops. These are special pieces of temporary ink you add to your inkwell to help you deploy cards and glimmers into play much quicker. In addition, having an ink drop in play may give you the ability to draw additional cards, power up your stats, or upgrade actions. Click below to discover how you can use this new power source.

upcomingSets.name: Into the Inkdark
upcomingSets.blurb: Every card inside a collector booster sports a beautiful foil, giving each a premium look and feel—and the rarer the card, the more magnificent its treatments and embellishments. Best of all, the likelihood of pulling a rarer Enchanted or Iconic card is much higher than that of a standard booster pack.
